integrity: The all-parameter result is established by the included mathematical proof. Finite exhaustive tests support, but do not replace, that proof. scientific_limitations: Binary alphabet, two nonempty constant runs and positive fixed occurrence frequency; no zero-frequency or three-run result. The finite profile enumeration is not claimed to run in polynomial time in the bit length of its input.
title: Exact fixed-frequency enumeration for every binary two-run subsequence pattern
